graph.title: LEGO City Train Station 7997
notes: Parts are listed up to the cut-off of the provided parts list (minifig parts not provided, so omitted). Total 367 nodes: 180 individual plus 187 inside repeats.

The booklet builds one set, not separate models: bag 1 (handcar, parcel trolley, track), bag 2 (platform), bags 3-4 (waiting room and ticket office, pinned together) and bag 5 (roof and tower). The final picture (step 23) shows all of them together: the track runs along the platform and the handcar sits on the track. These placement links are 'rest' links (a contact edge plus a joined edge with method 'rest'); nothing is actually fastened to the track.

Previously the four wheels used an attach override that left two wheels unconnected. They are now two repeats (front pair on b2, rear pair on b3) with no override, so every wheel is joined to the handcar.

The pictured steps do not show every individual connection, so many bulk pieces (walls, slopes, columns, caps, seats, pipes) are attached to one representative parent in repeats. Ports are left null for most studs.
Seats: 4 belong to the platform and 2 to the waiting room, but all 6 are attached to b54 for simplicity.

graph_initial.title: LEGO City Train Station 7997
notes: Parts are listed up to the cut-off of the provided parts list (minifig parts not provided, so omitted). Total 367 nodes: 180 individual plus 187 inside repeats.

The pictured steps do not make every individual connection identifiable; many bulk pieces (walls, slopes, columns, caps, seats, pipes) are attached to a single representative parent in repeats rather than their exact positions. Ports are left null for most studs.

Colour names follow the parts list. Three sub-models: handcar with trolley and track, the platform with canopies, and the station building (waiting room joined to ticket office with Technic pins, plus the roof and tower). The sticker sheet is joined to the parcel box.
Seats: 4 belong to the platform and 2 to the waiting room, but all 6 are attached to b54 for simplicity.
